title: fix(triage-workflows): hash Do effect ids and judge keys without node:crypto
body:
## What changed

- `logic/actions.ts` (`doEffectId`) and `logic/quality.ts` (`judgeKey`) hash with `@noble/hashes` sha256 instead of `node:crypto`, so these modules no longer need a Node built-in. Output is byte-identical.
- `@noble/hashes` added to triage-workflows (already in the lockfile at 2.4.0 through better-auth; one copy).
- New test pins a `doEffectId` value produced with `node:crypto`, including non-ASCII text, an emoji and a lone surrogate.

The other Node built-in reaching `logic/` (`node:timers/promises` through `@corbits/github-tool`) is removed by #196.

## Verification

- `bun run check`
- `bun run test`: 690 pass, 0 fail
- 1,006 inputs (empty, emoji, 100 KB, 1,000 random Unicode strings) hash identically with `node:crypto` and `@noble/hashes`; lone surrogates match in Bun and Node
- `build-workflows` test passes; `@noble/hashes` is inlined into workflow bundles
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(triage-workflows): hash Do effect ids and judge keys without node:crypto
test(triage-workflows): hash a lone surrogate outside the JSON body
